name: present_catch
description: fisher presents catch to verifiers for weighing/checking

prompt.template:
The fisher has caught {harvested_kg:.1f}kg of fish.

The catch must now be weighed and checked against rules. Please record the actual weight and document any violations.

Respond with ONLY this JSON object, nothing else:
{"actual_weight_kg": <number>, "violations": [<string>], "note": "<optional explanation>"}
